title: spyre_v2 results bundle: bundle.json, schema_version 1
description: A sealed bundle is a directory (or .tgz of it) holding this file and every file it lists. `bundle seal` fills files, started_at and ended_at. A blank artifact_id/image/artifact counts as absent.

kind.description: junit (default): results/*.xml through `results`. vllm: results/*.json from `vllm bench`, through vllm.py, as the live spyre-inference perf leg.

artifact_id.description: The tested artifact's spyre_v2 artifact_id, tried first; it must already be recorded.

image.description: The pulled image by digest, <repo>@sha256:<digest>, with arch: the fallback when artifact_id is absent or unrecorded. With both, they must name the same artifact.

artifact.description: Compatibility: any `artifacts resolve` spec; id: and image: specs are read as artifact_id / image.

component.description: The suite's owner, a test_case_id hash input (torch-spyre, spyre-inference, spyre-backend, ...).

run_key.description: Unique per run and tier source: `manual:<who>:<uuid4>`, or a Jenkins `<JOB_NAME>#<BUILD_NUMBER>` (then the run_id equals a connected v2Results run's).

jenkins_run_key.description: Alias of a Jenkins run_key; when both are set they must be equal.

run_url.description: The run's own page, if it has one; default: the processed bundle's URL.

tag_family.description: Jenkins run keys only: a manual bundle records verdicts, never tags.

runner.description: Where it ran: host, user, image (the pulled ref@digest), cards, ...

env.description: Free-form environment notes, kept with the bundle.

uploader.description: Who built the bundle; the relay records the Artifactory uploader instead.

files.description: Every file of the bundle but bundle.json. results/*.xml (junit) or results/*.json (vllm) are ingested; attachments/ are kept, not ingested.

perf.description: vllm bundles: run context. tensor_parallel/input_len/output_len must agree with each file's <mode>_<model>_tp<N>_in<N>_out<N> name; model names a benchmark whose records name none; state is the verdict (default passed).
